svg.title: Black, gray, and white box: how much the tester knows before starting
svg.desc: Black box: the tester knows nothing and must discover everything, the most realistic outside view but the most time spent on reconnaissance. Gray box: partial knowledge such as user credentials or network diagrams, a common balance that also simulates an insider or a foothold. White box, also called crystal box: full knowledge of source code, architecture, and earlier scans, giving the widest coverage at the lowest cost per finding but less realism.
svg.text: Black, gray, and white box: how much the tester knows before starting
